_how: Copy to config/board_in_E.json and fill in measured values (mm, deg). Delete the block you do not use. Grid origin = the printed top-left corner of the ChArUco grid (column line 0 / row line 0); title text toward the camera wall; long side along the box depth.
_d_x: sled tongue end face (touching both robot lobes) to grid column line 0 (CAD intent 101.1), mean of both grid ends
_d_y: key centre line to grid row line 0, toward the camera wall (CAD intent 89.2)
_h_K: board top above the surface the robot base stands on (3 points)
_yaw: (d_x at one grid end - d_x at the other) / 180 mm, in degrees

_or_method_mat._a: mat front edge (robot side) to grid column line 0
_or_method_mat._b: mat left edge (camera side) to grid row line 0
_or_method_mat._t: board thickness above the mat top
